n:
How the game handle lag in CPU bound situations.
Mostly relevant with large part count vessels.

Lower value :
Higher and smoother FPS, but game time might advance slower than real time.

Higher value :
Lower and choppier FPS, but game time will advance closer to real time.

t:
游戏在受 CPU 性能限制时的卡顿处理方式。
主要影响高部件数的载具。

较低数值：
帧率更高且更平滑，但游戏内时间推进可能慢于现实时间。

较高数值：
帧率更低且更卡顿，但游戏内时间推进更接近现实时间。
